title: Diatoms: Tiny Factories You Can See From Space
summary: An episode of Journey to the Microcosmos, hosted by Hank Green, about diatoms, single-celled algae with glass shells. It covers their role in producing a large share of Earth's oxygen and their uses in beer filtering, paint and kitty litter.
why: HN commenters recommend the series as an excellent, accessible introduction to microscopic life, using this episode as the diatom primer.

quote.text: I recently learned about them from an excellent Journey to the Microcosmos video
